description: Checks up to 12 of a Shopify store’s product pages, spread over product types, sale and stock, against Google’s merchant listing and product rich result rules, using Google’s Required, Recommended and Agreement levels and wording. It compares each page’s markup with Shopify’s own product data and Shopify Catalog, checks the product list for missing descriptions, images, brands, categories and buyer details and whether Shopify Catalog searches find the right products, and, when the markup lacks the store’s policies, returns a paste-ready return and shipping policy JSON-LD block built only from its own policy pages, saying where in the theme it goes. Free, no sign-in; waits up to 45 seconds of a run’s usual 2–4 minutes. Shared per store for an hour. Anything it could not check is reported as unknown.

domain.description: The Shopify storefront to check, e.g. example.com. Required until a store is connected; afterwards, omit it to use a connected store.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.
